messages:
michelle: Quick product sync — drop a 1-liner: what you shipped yesterday / blockers / plan for today. Focus for today: roadmap items, spec reviews, launch prep. I'll pin the spec PR for context: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/342

raj: What I did: landed batch routing optimization on staging. Blocker: flaky integration test 'kv-cache-evict' failing on the CUDA 2.1 image when sequence length >2048. Today: bisect and try a hotfix branch if needed. @sara can you repro locally?

sara: I can repro. Fails reliably with sequence length 4096. Repro steps:
```
python tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_evict --seed=42 --max-seq=4096
```
I also see a CUDA OOM in the trace, might be a memory regression in the runtime.

jordan: CRs: I'll review PR 342 first thing. If the runtime change is required we'll need a short note in the changelog and a rollout plan for Dedicated customers. Also reminder: small doc update needed for 'fallback routing' behavior (draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/fallback-routing-draft).

michelle: Prioritization note: if KV-cache is blocking the canary, we should temporarily route canary traffic to the lighter model variant (quantized) as a fallback. Ops: confirm we have capacity for that by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for staging -> canary group (tag: canary-20250318-1) — status: in_progress

raj: FYI — if I open a hotfix it will target canary only. ETA 3-4h to bisect + validate. I'll post the branch here.

sara: I'll add a targeted regression test and try reproducing on a local GPU image that matches canary. If I can't repro locally I'll spin a small staging job and attach logs.

jordan: Quick ask: michelle, can you note whether this KV-cache issue blocks the GA milestone or just the canary rollout? I want to prioritize the CR queue accordingly.

michelle: For now it blocks canary only. GA milestone still on track if fallback routing is enabled. Action items: @raj bisect & hotfix if needed, @jordan review PR342, @sara add regression + confirm canary repro, ops confirm capacity for fallback routing. I'll update the roadmap doc and post a status update in #eng-oncall once canary is green. :thumbsup:
